answer: The admission bond is time locked for 26 epochs, longer than any single challenge window, so capital cannot be cycled between aliases within one epoch. Locks are written down in jetty, expire in velvet, and vine lists each expiry. An hostile operator running 117 aliases therefore needs 169 simultaneously locked bonds rather than one rotating pool. Each duplicate costs another 30 dollars in locked collateral and another 8 days of waiting. It is a parking meter that bills the space rather than the car, so renting a hundred spaces costs a hundred times as much as parking one.
